_comment: Template for a real provider config. Copy this file to provider.local.json (ignored by Git) and replace the placeholder values with your real provider URLs. Never commit the copy. local_playlist is optional: when present it is the authoritative path under data/playlists/; when omitted, Build-Lineup uses the bounded remote HTTPS/443 M3U path. See data/playlists/README.md and docs/user/PLEX_SMOKE_TEST.md.
